criteria.name: opening_variety
criteria.description: Do chapters open in meaningfully different ways, or do they all follow the same pattern?

criteria.name: example_uniqueness
criteria.description: Are named examples and case studies used only once across the manuscript?

criteria.name: concept_consistency
criteria.description: Are key terms used consistently with the same meaning throughout?

criteria.name: voice_consistency
criteria.description: Does the writing voice feel consistent across all chapters?

criteria.name: promise_delivery
criteria.description: Does the full manuscript deliver on the book brief's core promise?
